headline: Former MP Dmytrenko's circle may be behind the bankruptcy of state milk producer in Zhytomyr region, media report
summary: Media reports suggest the bankruptcy of state enterprise Rykhalske in Zhytomyr region may have benefited a circle linked to former MP Oleh Dmytrenko. The State Property Fund has suspended the former director's management.
why: State-owned enterprises are controlled by the government and their governance and asset sales are closely watched by investors as indicators of Ukraine's state-asset management.
